apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - namespace.yaml
  - vuoro-work-runtime.secret.yaml
  - vuoro-work-migration.secret.yaml
  - vuoro-execution-runtime.secret.yaml
  - vuoro-execution-migration.secret.yaml
  - vuoro-execution-completion-ingest-runtime.secret.yaml
  - vuoro-execution-completion-read-runtime.secret.yaml
  - vuoro-knowledge-runtime.secret.yaml
  - vuoro-knowledge-migration.secret.yaml
  - vuoro-audit-runtime.secret.yaml
  - vuoro-audit-migration.secret.yaml
  - backup-credentials.yaml
  - vuoro-postgres.yaml
  # Live gate chain only. v6/v8/v8-v2 (suspended, superseded), v4-work,
  # the superseded v8-quiescence-v2 and session-limits-v1 one-offs, the
  # smoke v2/v3 predecessors, and the v10/v11 backup pins were archived
  # under docs/migrations/archive/vuoro-shared-db/ (Wave 4, 2026-08-26).
  #
  # 2026-09-02 rebuild: migrate-v4 and execution v2/v8-v3/v10/v11-v2/v12
  # joined them. This estate is reconstituted by restoring the barman
  # archive, not by replaying migrations, so on a rebuild every one of
  # those Jobs meets a ledger already at its target and refuses --
  # correctly ("remote schema is newer than this migration package
  # (actual=12, current=5)"; "refusing unexpected pre-migration ledger:
  # [1..12]"). They were retained only because ../ks.yaml healthChecks
  # named them, which turned each correct refusal into a stuck
  # Kustomization. v8-v3 could not even start: it names a ServiceAccount
  # vuoro-execution-migrate-v8 that no manifest here creates, so it
  # survived only on an SA left behind in the old cluster.
  #
  # Filenames were renamed to match the Job name they contain (was
  # vuoro-schema-grants-v1.yaml, vuoro-migrate-v1.yaml).
  - vuoro-schema-grants-v3.yaml
  - actionq-smoke-schema-migrate-v4.yaml
  - sprintctl-legacy-source.secret.yaml
  - networkpolicy-sprintctl-backfill.yaml
  - service-lb.yaml
  - service-lb-pool.yaml
  - cnpg-pgdump-age.yaml
  # vuoro-work-migrate-v12 to -v18 (spent, Complete) are archived under
  # docs/migrations/archive/vuoro-shared-db/.
  - vuoro-work-migrate-v25.yaml
